<thought>We will use the slab CIF we already have and a minimal valid CO₂ CIF (with proper data block name and required loops). The adsorption site JSON is empty, so we’ll place the CO₂ at the default position with a height of 2.0 Å. After generating the combined structure, we will write it to a CIF file and return its path.</thought>
